summary: A pay correction in {place} follows workers from another branch when they cross town for a shift.
realLife: After an escape room wage complaint, its employer raised pay for Denver workers and for Centennial workers on shifts in Denver.
gates: A single employer assigns staff across a wage boundary.
weights: Frequent cross-branch assignments expose more shifts to the city rate.
inGame: needs: work locations, shift dates and applicable local rates.

turns.what: The other branch's staff never cross the boundary.
turns.pulledBy: The assignment log puts every shift outside town.
turns.writesBack: The correction covers only the city crew.

turns.what: Only part of a shift took place inside town.
turns.pulledBy: The work record lists two locations.
turns.writesBack: Payroll separates the hours by location.
